meta.name: Astral Observatory+
meta.notes: Native sheets are 1px = 1 art pixel; x5 sheets are 5x with the 1px dark outline (tiles are not outlined). Shots point right; rotate in-engine. Floating creatures get the renderer hover in HOVER (do not bake bobs).

astrolabe_sentinel.title: Astrolabe Sentinel
astrolabe_sentinel.ability_text: Raises the astrolabe shield into a ring ward that blocks shots for 2s, then releases it as a shockwave.

comet_hound.title: Comet Hound
comet_hound.ability_text: Crouches, then streaks across the room in a straight line, leaving a burning trail that lingers for 2s.

nebula_weaver.title: Nebula Weaver
nebula_weaver.ability_text: Spreads its wings and sheds a cloud of star-dust (radius 3) that hides it and slows players inside for 3s.

vault_keeper.title: Vault Keeper
vault_keeper.ability_text: Rams its key into the floor: seal glyphs ring the treasure room and the doors lock until it dies. Spawns dormant ('wake' frame 0) beside the Star Vault; plays 'wake' when the chest is opened or it is hit.

meteor_mite.title: Meteor Mite
meteor_mite.text: Skitters in packs of 4-6; bursts in a ring of embers on death.

lens_wisp.title: Lens Wisp
lens_wisp.text: Hangs back and focuses a beam; flees when players close in.

astrolabe_sentinel.star_lance.text: Fast straight lance of light, pierces.

astrolabe_sentinel.astro_disc.text: Slow spinning ring that boomerangs back.

comet_hound.comet_spark.text: Quick homing-lite comet, fired in threes.

nebula_weaver.nebula_thread.text: Wavy thread fired in a fan of 5.

nebula_weaver.dust_mote.text: Slow cluster that splits into 3 motes.

vault_keeper.seal_glyph.text: Rune that hangs in place 0.5s, then flies at the nearest player.

meteor_mite.ember_chunk.text: Death burst: 8 embers in a ring.

lens_wisp.focus_beam.text: Fast narrow beam, fired after a 0.5s glint.

void_acolyte.void_orb.text: New: slow orb that pulls players 1 tile toward it on hit.

orrery_drone.cog_shot.text: New: spinning cog, ricochets off walls once.

constellation_stalker.star_claw.text: New: twin star-claw crescent at close range.

grand_orrery.meteor.text: New boss shot: falls from above onto a marked tile (use with a rune_circle telegraph).

vault.trap_spark.text: Treasure-room floor trap: sparks pop from vault_trap tiles in sequence.

grand_orrery.singularity.text: Grand Orrery (Collapse phase): drops 2-3 singularities that drift slowly and pull players within 3 tiles toward them; touching the core deals heavy damage. Lasts 6s, then collapses.

relic_pedestal.note: baked: the relic's bob is in the frames, plinth must stay still

mid_tier.comet_hound: packs of 2 in the star-map halls
mid_tier.nebula_weaver: 1 per skylight hall, hangs over astral_skylight tiles

treasure_room.entrance: vault_door (sealed until the Grand Orrery's 'Aligned' phase is broken, or by a vault key drop)
treasure_room.flow: Open chest -> chest plays 'open' -> Vault Keeper plays 'wake' -> fight (Lockdown seals the vault_door) -> on death the doors unseal; the chest's loot table rolls when opened (loot is granted on keeper death).
